summary.en: Taliban forces demolished the entrance of a mosque in Maidan Wardak, while Russia expanded diplomatic contacts with the Taliban-led Afghan government. A Pakistani bank’s exit has cut a vital lifeline for Afghanistan’s banking sector, and a Russian military aircraft crashed, killing 19 people. In Pakistan, a high-voltage cable fell on a house in Turbat, killing a woman; a policeman was killed in Bannu; and two civilians died in a roadside blast in Zhob. Saudi Delta Energy announced a $30 billion gas infrastructure investment. The conflict recorded 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
